rationale: Naman brings production machine learning infrastructure expertise from Meta, while William is applying ML—specifically variational autoencoders—to a high-impact medical problem (neurodegenerative disease detection from neuroimaging). They can exchange practical insights on scaling ML models in research contexts: Naman on infrastructure patterns that handle real-world data pipelines, William on the domain challenges and validation needs in medical AI.
intro_message: Naman Shah, meet William Wakefield — Naman's ML infrastructure experience at Meta could help inform the technical architecture behind William's neuroimaging-based disease detection work.
